future_player_presentation_boundaries.dynamic_input: authorized CardInstanceState and typed legal actions
public market, weather, and route aggregates
public owner, rank, health, and build state
public unit position, health, and action state
public weather event phase and timing
authoritative public or authorized private victory receipts

atomic_cutover_sequence: Freeze shared presentation envelope, message references, and one theme-token catalog.
Establish stable semantic authority for Role, Monster, Product, Facility, Military, Weather, and Victory.
Move purchase, play, track, and drag legality into typed action authorities; missing actions fail closed.
Add new projectors beside legacy producers; dual output is test-only and production chooses one producer.
Cut static public consumers first: all Codex pages, region/facility detail, weather definitions, and victory copy.
Cut dynamic public consumers next: public track, map units, weather events, standings, and settlement.
Cut viewer-private hand, market, inspector, hover, and drag paths atomically with definition, instance, and actions.
Migrate role, monster, and product identity with versioned save and RNG parity before deleting bridges.
Redirect diagnostics to SemanticDiagnosticProjection and ban new raw skill or payload reads.
Delete aliases, text-driven routing, localized art inference, duplicate theme maps, and dual catalog fallbacks after caller counts reach zero.

privacy_risks.summary: True AI starter-monster name crosses the setup query boundary in monster_label before the renderer hides it.
District supply imports exact own cash and hand state into presentation to recompute actionability.
CardViewSnapshot and CardPresentationRuntimeService carry no intrinsic viewer-scope contract.
PublicTrackSnapshot trusts generic owner visibility aliases and raw owner fields.

preserved_privacy_controls: Card track and game-screen recursive scrub guards
Standings and settlement dual audit cash authorization
Bestiary omission of internal weights, random tickets, and preselected targets

compatibility_bridges.summary: Localized product IDs remain current authority across market, route, card, world, and save state.
Role portrait and navigation still use localized name or catalog index.
Monster Codex and art joins still use catalog index and localized name.
Card semantic catalog is 256 active and 92 projection_only at the audited baseline.
Existing scrubbers stay after typed viewer projections are authoritative.

blockers.summary: Strict card DTO has zero production consumers.
Market and drag/drop still synthesize actionability in presentation or UI.
Role passive rule authority is not established for all passive families.
Stable monster family identity is not universal in runtime and checkpoint data.
Localized product IDs require a versioned save and RNG-safe migration.
No single immutable FacilitySemanticSpec catalog feeds region and market presentation.
Weather effects and visual identity are duplicated across service, view model, telemetry, and UI.
True AI starter monster crosses the setup query boundary before renderer hiding.
The new card projector has no production-authorized localization source or composition.

required_scan_gates: ban presentation effect_payload and raw skill reads outside explicit migration allowlists
ban localized names, labels, tooltip text, or colors from selecting action, route, target, rule, rank, or handler
require viewer cropping before private values enter a DTO
ban per-frame or per-render semantic compilation
unknown semantic operations must not render as executable
require stable message refs and presentation token IDs
require legal actions from authoritative action/query owners
preserve renderer-only layout, focus, animation, accessibility, and scrub behavior
